drafts.subject: Opportunity for a Java Developer
drafts.body:
Hi there,

I hope you are having a great week. I am reaching out because I believe your profile could be a great fit for an open Java Developer position we are currently filling. We are looking for a dedicated professional to join our team and contribute to our ongoing projects.

Since no specific minimum experience is required for this role, it is an excellent opportunity for someone eager to apply their Java skills in a supportive environment. We value talent and potential, and I would love to connect to discuss how your background aligns with our needs.

If you are open to new opportunities, please let me know a convenient time for a brief chat. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best regards,
Recruiting Team
